label: Static files
summary: Static site: a git repository served by Caddy. No database. A frontend (React, Vue, Astro…) is built beforehand and shipped as its output (e.g. dist/).
guide: Your content is a git branch or an uploaded package. It is inspected, then goes live within about 2 minutes.
If a new release fails inspection or does not answer, the last good release stays live.
Files are served as they are by Caddy from the repository (or the configured subdirectory). No database, nothing runs on the server.
Build any frontend beforehand and ship its output (for example dist/) in the branch or package.
